method: Generated localized sprite edits, followed by deterministic masked compositing onto stand.png. Limitation disclosed before generation. No generated head/body used outside masks.
common_constraints: The exact original Midori sprite is the edit target. Edit ONLY both arms from shoulders through fingers, the loose ribbed sweater sleeves, one ivory teacup and any requested steam. Preserve original head, green hair strands and silhouette, neutral open eyes, tiny smile, collar, sweater torso, skirt, bare legs, green socks and black boots. Match original thin dark outline, watercolor/anime pencil texture and soft shading. Full-body original 239x400 proportions and framing, transparent background. No vector-simplified sleeves, extra limbs, ghost silhouettes, motion blur, crossfade, text or sprite sheet. Closed eyes/happy expressions will come from existing game overlays, not from image generation.
